reviews.text: Such a great experience. The tour guide was so nice and we had a blast loving on all the cows,cats, dogs and goats!

What an amazing venue! So many options for set up and photo backgrounds. You can even stay on site. The staff is so friendly and helpful! My son and daughter in-law had an amazing experience here! Thank you!

This is a very beautiful place.  Lots of landscaping locations for pictures.  The owner is very attentive to your party.  It is setup and designed for weddings.  THe owner makes sure every little detail is taken care of.  You will have a wonderful experience like my son just had for his wedding.  I highly recommend the Highland Farms for your wedding.

There were a bunch of cute animals and a Highland cow for the couple to walk up to the cocktail/dinner area. Such a wonderful time. Between Doma and Duante, this tour was such a joy to take part in. I will be telling my friends about this out of the way gem. Thanks all!

All staff were courteous, helpful and professional.  I couldn't say enough about Highland Farm.

What a nice, calm and beautiful place to visit. Very well kept.
Thank you for a great visit! We will be back.

The tour was AWESOME!  Doma was a great guide, very knowledgeable, and I he is as much of a cow lover as me!  The farm is incredibly gorgeous.  The work they put in to make it beautiful is very inspiring.  Would recommend everyone come to this place and support the farm.

My husband drove me down here for my birthday for this experience and it was amazing! Eliza was just perfect at explaining everything and remembering the names of all the beautiful animals! 100/10. I would definitely come back if I’m in the area again!
This place is amazing! So peaceful and relaxing! The staff are so kind as well. Will definitely be coming back soon!

My husband surprised me with a private tour of Highland Farms for our 25th anniversary. I was in heaven! Staff is amazing. Gorgeous place and the grass Puppies (highland cows) were to die for. So sweet and friendly. The sheep loved their scratches. I would highly recommend going to visit Highland Farms

I had the wedding of my dreams at Highland Farms, it is the perfect destination wedding venue! The staff were so helpful and kind my whole stay. They did everything from bartending to set up and even helped with a cow photoshoot. Connor, AJ, Doma, Eliza, Hudson and Daunte where all incredible. I couldn't recommend this venue more!

We had a wonderful night at Highland Farms. The farm tour was super fun - our guides were so friendly and clearly adore the animals. All of the animals are so friendly and well taken care of. The property is immaculate. We stayed in The Cottage and it was clean and super comfortable. The hot tub and morning wake up call from Albie the peacock were highlights. Every single person we encountered was friendly and great. We had a great little getaway and will recommend to our friends.

We had the best experience at Highland Farms for our wedding! The venue is absolutely beautiful, and our guests loved everything about the property- from the farm tour and Highland cows to the Nordic spa and staying onsite.

Connor and his team went above and beyond all weekend. We got behind during setup, and Connor even jumped in to arrange our altar flowers, which meant so much to us. You can tell they genuinely care about making your day special.

We couldn't have asked for a better venue and would recommend Highland Farms to anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable wedding experience.
A++ experience! The sauna, sream room and cold plunge were exactly what my wife and I needed! Beautiful surroundings and a very friendly staff! Thanks a million 😊

We couldn't have asked for a more beautiful venue to have our wedding than Highland Farms. The only thing I knew I wanted when I was looking at venues was that I wanted something "foresty". Highland Farms delivered the enchanting forest vibes, plus cutie highland cows and a cozy cabins to get ready in. Unfortunately, they did lose their venue coordinator about 3 days prior to the wedding, which created some hiccups, but the venue owner Connor took full accountability for the balls that got dropped as a result, and the HF staff (particularly Daunte and Doma) went above and beyond to keep things running. I would be remiss if I didn't mention the guest of honor Cowboy mingling during dinner. Thank you to the entire HF team for making our day so special!

I will absolutely be returning. We did the nordic spa sauna and cold plunge. The property was impeccable. The spa area was clean and in perfect condition. Mary was awesome, so kind and accommodating.  I have been to different spas over the years and this experience has been my favorite so far. Mary put the experience over the top. A suggestion to make the experience even better would be to have clearer directions in an email about where to go when you arrive. When we got there the place was empty and we were worried we went to the wrong spot.

Highland Farms is such a unique place to visit! Dante took us on a tour of the entire grounds and the work they have put into making it look very natural and modern. We booked to see the Highland cows and got to see cows, sheep, the white peacocks, and everything else they have to offer! We were very impressed with the knowledge of Dante and all he taught us about everything at Highland Farms!

My son and his wife just had the most beautiful wedding ceremony and celebration at Highland Farms. The location is perfect for an elegant but not stuffy wedding. The staff helped to make sure everything went to plan and they were all so kind, helpful, efficient, and organized. Everything was perfect!
Went for three days for my friends wedding. Would recommend 10/10. Amenities, views, and service all were on point. Employees like Dante will keep you and your group in good hands.

I chose Highland Farms for my wedding venue primarily for the amenities offered. I was planning the wedding while in my final year at school. Connor approached our call softly, understanding the overwhelm of my situation. He explained all of the packages and followed up consistently— not constantly.

When I toured the venue 5 months later, I was comforted by the respect of the staff, particularly Dante who has been with the farm “since the beginning.” I believe Dante truly understood the depth of the farm; both in purpose and future possibilities. Both he and Connor have a vision for the property. Additionally, I would like to mention, our tour was highly accommodating to my circumstances of flying home for the holidays.

Leading into the wedding, Connor scheduled a few check-ins and offered himself as a day-of coordinator. I used the vision Connor had for his venue as a base structure for our wedding, but Connor also offered a few options for us to make it most enjoyable for us, particularly, a table for just my husband and I to enjoy our dinner together separate from our guests.

When we arrived at the venue, I was overwhelmed with all of the pre-wedding decisions to be made (where to put the boxes of table cloths, etc). Having already completed a tour of the farm previously, Connor and his staff were able to take my wedding party on a tour while I figured out some logistics. This stood out in particular, because it showed Connor understood the pressure I thought I was under.

When it came to the rehearsal, Connor was able to effectively communicate to my wedding party, many of whom have never attended a wedding. Additionally, he gave me words of advice that I would otherwise have not considered. The day of the wedding I saw Connor very few times, that was mostly to do with my own pre-wedding nerves. However, Connor was consistently communicating with my point of contact. And he was there for the ceremony itself, which was most important to me. He also had staff that were there and available for covering photos and captured incredible candid moments.

Overall, the support of the team at highland farms, the amenities offered, and the quality of service lead me to encourage my friends and family members to consider Highland Farms for their weddings.

Went to the Nordic spa at Highland farms. It is such a cute setup. The service was excellent. Mary our host was super kind and informative. She did an amazing job to make our visit one we will look back fondly on. My only suggestion is to install the hand rail for the cold plunge and have a sign or make a note in the instructions where to meet the host/farmhand at the cow statue. We gave ourselves a self guided tour by accident.

My experience here was amazing, we all had fun at the weeding! The staff was so kind. One of my favorite things here was either the highland cows or the nature. The nature was SO beautiful. I recommend stopping by if your in Oregon!

Our son had his wedding here and it was absolutely perfect. Room for everyone to hang out and visit, we spent the weekend and it was all amazing. The staff took such good care of us and were extremely kind and helpful the whole time. The grounds and animals were well cared for and fun to interact with. From breakfast to bonfires we had a wonderful time!!!

My mom and I had a private tour of the farm with tour guild, Mary. It was absolutely wonderful! Mary went above and beyond sharing so many insightful stories, giving tips along the way as we were in awe of all the animals. 10/10 recommend!

Amazing experience! We did the farm tour followed by the spa and had the best time. AJ was a wonderful tour guide, very knowledgeable and very passionate about all the animals here! Would recommend for a forest getaway!

I took a tour of the farm and pet the highland cows with my husband. The guides felt like long lost friends, and the cows were so sweet... Mamas and their babies. The property is serene and calm and beautiful. We also met Icelandic sheep, peacocks, and Indian sheep dogs. Definitely an experience you'll not want to miss! We will be back for the sauna and spa!

This was our first trip for the sauna and cold plunge package. It was an experience I’ve never had. Staff was the friendliest group of people I’ve met in a long time. They showed us around the property, let us pet and admire the highland cows, and the sauna was absolutely stunning. Not just the feel and experience of the sauna itself, but the atmosphere and scenery was amazing! I will be looking forward to another trip, and another, and another. Staff and facility gets as many stars as I can possibly add. This was the perfect end to a vacation for my family from SC and an amazing way for me to end a week of going all across northwest Oregon for a solid 5 days. It was the perfect way to come back to relaxing and ready to start new. Thank you so much for the best hour and a half in a very long time.

Booked the 1 1/2 hour Nordic spa experience and had an amazing time. The spa is clean, well stocked with water, tea and coffee, and felt amazing. The staff were all incredibly kind and seemed like they loved their job. Hoping to come back again soon!

My partner and I booked the Nordic Spa Experience. We had an amazing time! The staff was amazingly helpful, friendly and informative. The spas were impeccably clean and welcoming. There were plenty of towels and amenities for private respectful self-sevice. The features were very user-friendly. We felt valued and respected, and were never rushed even though we drug our feet looking at all the lovely animals. Love the fact that we could pay for items in the online shop and pick them up that day. The only request we may have had is that many of the essential oils were low to empty, but that in no way tarnished our experience! We are now wanting to plan a farm stay and will definitely be returning soon.

The tour of the farm was absolutely amazing. Dante was a fantastic tour guide. My family had the greatest time. Thank you for making it perfect for my birthday. I loved the baby cows. I'll see you all next year.

This was a tough one for me. I was really looking forward to our farm tour and I wanted to love it. Unfortunately, I can't say that I did and I wouldn't recommend doing a farm tour to anyone else.
There were some positives, the staff was lovely, the grounds were beautiful and the cows seemed happy and well cared for.
Here's why I'm only giving two stars, we paid for the farm tour that specifically states, hands on experience with all farm animals. That's absolutely not what we got. We were walked over to a pen with one mom and baby who we looked at from outside the pen before moving on. Then we walked to a second pen where we were allowed inside to interact but again, it was with one mom and baby. This was literally the only interaction we had with any animals. Everything else was locked up in a pen. We could see them but there was zero interaction. The remainder of our tour was walking the grounds listening to what came suspiciously close to a sales pitch for booking other parts of the business.
This was not what I envisioned when I paid $75 per person, whatsoever. Unfortunately, I'd say save your money on this one if you're wanting to visit for the animals.

owner_reply.text:
Hi Amy, thank you for taking the time to write this, and for being so fair about it. It means a lot that you saw the care we put into our animals and the grounds, even on a day that didn't fully land for you.

I do want to gently share how the tour is built, because there's more intention behind it than it may have felt in the moment. We're an educational, hands on experience, and those two halves are deliberate. We start with the education, introducing you to our animals and sharing how we run a small farm and the practices we genuinely care about. This is important as we love these animals and want people to leave understanding them, not just having seen them. Then we move into the hands-on part: private time in the pasture with a couple different cows, hopefully a momma and her baby, so you may interact with different ages for as long as you'd like. We do this for your safety, so you may be as close as possible without us having to worry about others cows interrupting your time. That one on one time is the heart of our tours, and we start the day building toward it. These are living animals as well, so we rotate our Highland cows with guests to keep them happy and unstressed rather than worn out by back to back visits. 

The walk through of the grounds is something guests typically love because of where we sit, in the national forest, and it's never meant to feel like a pitch. I'm sorry that it came across that way.

That said, you're right, and it's on us. Our listing says "hands-on with all farm animals," and that word, all, promised more than your tour delivered by the sounds of it. And beyond the wording, your visit didn't reflect what a tour with us should feel like, and I'm sorry for that. We can and do deliver a richer, more hands-on experience than you got, and I'd like the chance to make sure of it for you. 

I'd genuinely love to have you back as my guest and show you the tour the way it's meant to feel. Please email info@highlandfarms-oregon.com and ask for me directly. Thank you again.  -Connor

reviews.text: What can I say but a DREAM COME TRUE!!!! I am in LOVE with Highland cows! My husband and I were on a "mini" vacation this past weekend in Washington to visit a location that had Highland cows there. I was searching for other places on line and came across Highland Farms!! This was on our way home so my husband scheduled us a personal tour for Sunday afternoon. As we were driving up the road to this location, we were in awe of the gorgeous forest and this beautiful, serene location! While entering you see this amazing Highland cow statue that was originally a tree but some creative individual (kudos to you, whoever made this)  made this awesome sign! We met an employee by the name of Daunte who gave us our personal tour. We started off meeting 4 of the cows in a newly fenced area, 2 momma's and 2 babies along with some goats. One of the momma's, "Missy" came over to greet us along with her baby and we were able to feed them. After that we headed to the barn where we met a couple more momma's and babies! We were able to pet them and even "brush" them! This was sooooo amazing! Daunte gave us some food to feed them as well. During the whole tour, Daunte was just full of so much information about these beautiful creatures! You can tell he truly loves his job and the animals that he cares for. What a very docile and calm animal! I was in ultimate heaven being able to pet them, be up close with them, brush them, love them, even though it was about 95 degrees out, I would sweat all day long to be with these lovely animals! During this tour we were also able to meet some peacocks, chickens and their two watch dogs! They have a nice small cottage on the premises you can reserve as well as the house itself, an airstream or all three if you so choose! Anyways, I can't say enough about Highland Farms! It was incredible to meet the Highland cow family as well as the other animals. My family and I will be making this a regular stop from here on out. If you get on their website, they have some "merch" but are working on coming out with some more... so hop on there and support this place.... they are truly amazing in what they do and Daunte.... you were great!! (This kid deserves a raise!!!) Thank you for making this girl's dream come true!!! xo

Plenty of room for everyone to have their own area but common spaces for events and great for people to feel immersed in nature. Easy to get to, at just an hour from Portland. The terrain can be a little challenging for differently abled people but we had no issue with our older folks. The animals were quiet and well cared for, lil barn cats are very sweet. Cowboy is a spunky lil guy. Everyone raved that all the rooms and beds were comfy. Definitely recommend comfy shoes as there will be quite a bit of walking.

The wedding guests loved having the animals to look at and the grounds to explore, the whole family can stay and theres a trail that wraps through the land. Plenty of space to reminisce and land to cherish.

Lastly, Connor and his team were super helpful along the way. They helped with set up and breakdown but without being overbearing. Were there to just support us in anyway we needed, staying on call through the wedding and stay. Worked with us for all our needs. This was a learning curve for both of us and our communication fell through at different times on both sides but thats expected in the hustle and bustle of life. His connections to the community is an added bonus as he worked with my caterers to ensure everything was returned correctly. Had recommendations for local places and also has different meats, eggs and wood to purchase to keep your needs met without the headache.

Thanks again for everything.

Some friends and I stayed in The Lodge at Highland Farms to celebrate a birthday over the weekend. It was a little different than what I expected, but overall a good time.

We arrived on a Friday night around 8:30, and something felt a bit off. I had booked through the site, and communicated with the owner of the property the previous week. The morning of he sent an email with directions and various other house information (WiFi password, house rules, where we could find towels, etc). When we got to the property it was dark and the door was simply left unlocked. Maybe my friends and I have just heard too many stories over the years, but we were all unnerved. We did a sweep of the house to make sure we were well and truly alone. I reached out to the owner to make sure we were in the right spot, he confirmed it, and we hesitantly settled in. None of us slept very well the first night.

The next morning we began to enjoy our stay. The farm looks very different in the daylight, and it is a nice area. There are two decent sized pens with a handful of cows and two dogs in each, and two dogs in a pen by a barn that has ducks, peacocks, sheep, and chickens. The dogs are young, kept on leads, and are all sweethearts. We met Tiffany, and her husband Brett who was clearing a tree that had fallen overnight. Tiffany gave us a tour alongside another family. These two really are the stars of the show, their knowledge and passion for the wellbeing of all animals here is astounding. They are kind people who made our trip so much more enjoyable and put us completely at ease. After the tour, where we pet many cows (and dogs) through the fence and came inside the pen to see the sheep, we went back inside to play games, watch a movie, have dinner, and celebrate a birthday. Throughout the afternoon we were able to wander the property and give some love to the animals on our own. They are fun creatures to watch, and each dog definitely has their own personality.

I expected this to be a large, established farm, and the lodge to simply be a spare building that’s rented out so there would be an owner or family there throughout the stay.  While that wasn’t the case, I still had a great weekend. I think the owner has grand plans for this place and the farm certainly has a lot of potential. Between Tiffany and Brett’s expertise and Connor’s ambition I really think this farm can turn into a spectacular place.
